summary: Iteration 2 retest of the 8 fixes from iteration 1, plus light RBAC, acompanhar and export regression. Pytest: 75/75 passed (53 regression tests plus 22 new ones in test_iter2_fixes.py). Playwright: desktop login through the UI worked for TEST_SUP, TEST_PCP and 1025. The roteiro edit modal on /supervisor/roteiro/gerenciar opens with the data filled in through the preview URL (Corte/SR-01/1.5, action /supervisor/roteiro/editar/1). The export buttons are now light text on dark blue. No JS pageerrors when operador or pcp click the page. On mobile 390px, the /pcp table is in an overflow-x:auto wrapper (table 375px inside a 338px container, document width 390), and the Fases button opens /pcp/acompanhar/OP-002 showing 50.0%, the stopped-phase alert and the previsão. All 8 fixes are verified.

minor.issue: Both still use the old progresso formula (meta - SUM(saldos))/meta. Multi-phase OPs show 0% here, which does not match /pcp (50.0% for OP-002). Use the meta*nfases formula.

issues: The CSV button is still underlined while the other export buttons are not (cosmetic)
The date filters use the browser's native date picker (acceptable in this legacy Flask app)
The burger toggle only shows when aba=='supervisor', so a supervisor on /supervisor/relatorios has no ☰ button. It is minor because the nav tabs cover the same pages.

action_items: Optional: apply the multi-phase progresso formula in pcp_imprimir and the supervisor consulta OP detail
critical_code_review_comments: api_roteiro only checks for a login itself; RBAC comes from the /supervisor before_request, and pcp/operador get a 302 as verified. This is fine.
seed_data_creation: None. Read-only tests; no data or roles were changed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest from /app/backend/tests (test_iter2_fixes imports helpers from test_rbac_pcp). Supervisor login lands on /operador. The pod clock is ahead, so OPs showing as PARADA is expected.
